reason: Alert 1 (java/path-injection): alert-TP — resolved sink value includes user-controlled 'seg'. Variable 'seg' is populated from request.getParameter('seg') (line 21) with no validation, unlike 'host' which undergoes regex matching. The sink expression response.sendRedirect("https://" + host + "/" + seg) (line 24) incorporates this unvalidated input directly into the redirect URL, enabling potential open redirect attacks.
